quest.title: Fertilizer... Salesperson?
quest.description: Iwata of Watatsumi Island appears to be having some troubles...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x5

talks.objective: Return the next day and appraise the fertilizer situation

dialogues.speaker: Iwata
dialogues.text: *sigh* I do hope I succeed this time...

talks.objective: Return and appraise the fertilizer situation

dialogues.speaker: Iwata
dialogues.text: Thank you, Traveler, thank you...

dialogues.speaker: Iwata
dialogues.text: I was halfway through making the fertilizer when those monsters came charging up out of nowhere...

dialogues.speaker: Iwata
dialogues.text: That's so strange... But it's good that you showed up when you did.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It might be because of that pile of fertilizer, you know...

dialogues.speaker: Iwata
dialogues.text: R—Really? I've heard that this smell is a sign that you might have succeeded.

dialogues.speaker: Iwata
dialogues.text: Well, in any case, come over here and have a look at the fertilizer. I'll explain as I open it up...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Hold it!

dialogues.speaker: Iwata
dialogues.text: Eh? Mr. Gorou? I wasn't aware that you'd be passing this way today.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: On patrol, Gorou?

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: I... Uh, never mind that first.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Is this pile of... stuff your doing?

dialogues.speaker: Iwata
dialogues.text: Hahaha, yes. This fertilizer was the work of our hands.

dialogues.speaker: Iwata
dialogues.text: Mr. Gorou, did you come here to check on the fertilizer as well?

dialogues.speaker: Iwata
dialogues.text: Hehe, in that case, let's...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Wait! Hold on a moment. I'm not here for that. Wait, actually, I am... But...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Gorou's face is twisting up something awful...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's... adjourn to someplace a little further away...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Alright, let's do that.

dialogues.speaker: Iwata
dialogues.text: So, Mr. Gorou, why are you here?

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Lately, a lot of residents have been complaining of a terrifying stench nearby...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: So for safety, I came to investigate, and wound up following the smell all the way here.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: That's how I found you.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Iwata, I've heard that you've been researching fertilizer, but the way that you're going about it is...

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Basically. Either way, Iwata, could you please dispose of that fertilizer? We'll try to help you find some other way.

response.speaker: Ookubo Daisuke
response.text: Sir! General Gorou!

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: I'm here. What's happened?

response.speaker: Ookubo Daisuke
response.text: General, we caught a suspicious person out in the outskirts.

response.speaker: Ookubo Daisuke
response.text: She was acting very furtively, calling herself a... fertilizer salesperson, or somesuch.

response.speaker: Ookubo Daisuke
response.text: I thought that was awful strange, so I had this person detained. I thought that you might wish to see to her questioning.

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Fertilizer this, fertilizer that... What is it with me and fertilizer today...

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: I've got it. I'll be with you shortly. Head back first and help to maintain order.

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Iwata, please deal with the matter of the fertilizer. We'll discuss this further later.

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Traveler, why don't you come with me?

choices.text: Doesn't seem like there's anything else to do.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Someone selling fertilizer? Paimon can't help feel like that's familiar somehow... Nothing's coming to mind, though...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah well, whatever. Let's just go over there and see what's up!

dialogues.speaker: Iwata
dialogues.text: *sigh* Fertilizers are much trickier than I thought...

talks.objective: Go with Gorou to investigate the suspicious person

dialogues.speaker: Hiroyuki
dialogues.text: Stay right there and don't move!

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: I—I'm not moving! You asked me to explain, and I explained that I'm really a researcher from the Akademiya!

dialogues.speaker: Hiroyuki
dialogues.text: Didn't you say that you're advertising fertilizer?

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: I... Can't a researcher from the Akademiya also advertise for fertilizers? Just... Just listen to me for a moment, will you...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Is this the person?

dialogues.speaker: Ookubo Daisuke
dialogues.text: Yes, sir.

dialogues.speaker: Ookubo Daisuke
dialogues.text: When we caught her, she was sneaking around the place and wouldn't stop writing certain things down.

dialogues.speaker: Ookubo Daisuke
dialogues.text: General, I'm positive that she's a Shogunate spy!

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: I'm not! And I wasn't! I already told you, I'm a researcher! I was just collecting material for my thesis!

dialogues.speaker: Hiroyuki
dialogues.text: Cut the crap! Do you seriously expect us to believe that you'd walk into a battlefield over a thesis? You're definitely playing at something else!

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: ...What could I really dare to play at other than my thesis anyway...

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: Traveler! Oh, this is wonderful! Please tell them I'm not a bad person! I'm just here to write my thesis!

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: You know her?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well, you could say that...

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Does "graduating" really drive researchers from Sumeru this far up the wall...

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: But given what you've said, you're only acquaintances at best.

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: And as for her status as a "researcher from Sumeru," that's something you only heard from her, isn't it?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That's correct.

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Hmm... I'm afraid that none of the evidence here is conclusive.

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: But if she's got your guarantee, I'd wager that she isn't a bad person...

response.speaker: Ookubo Daisuke
response.text: General, if I may make a suggestion?

response.speaker: Ookubo Daisuke
response.text: Do you remember Kaushik? That researcher who's been studying our island's culture and history?

response.speaker: Ookubo Daisuke
response.text: He's been here all this while, and his credentials are quite solid... Why don't we ask him to tell if this... fertilizer saleswoman is actually a researcher or not?

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: That actually sounds like a decent plan. Traveler, could we trouble you to bring Kaushik here?

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Just in case of any incidents, I'll stay here and guard this... fertilizer saleswoman.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Alright.

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: It's up to you then. Come back as quickly as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Kaushik
dialogues.text: The meaning of this totem... Hmm? Traveler? Did you have some business with me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This is about Alrani...

dialogues.speaker: Kaushik
dialogues.text: Alrani's here? On Watatsumi Island? That's... odd. What's that girl doing here? Shouldn't she be in Liyue?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She was arrested by some soldiers...

dialogues.speaker: Kaushik
dialogues.text: What? *sigh* Of course. Coming to Watatsumi Island under the present circumstances... Of course they would suspect her.

dialogues.speaker: Kaushik
dialogues.text: Never mind that for now. Let's head over and help that reckless girl out...

talks.objective: Take Kaushik and report back to Gorou

dialogues.speaker: Kaushik
dialogues.text: Alrani! It really is you! B—But why are you here in Inazuma? Weren't you supposed to be in Liyue?

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: This... Oh, this is going to be long story, isn't it...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Mr. Kaushik, you know Alrani?

dialogues.speaker: Kaushik
dialogues.text: Oh, you... you're General Gorou, aren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Kaushik
dialogues.text: You surmise correctly. Alrani and I are both researchers from the Akademiya.

dialogues.speaker: Kaushik
dialogues.text: After that, we left the Akademiya to conduct fieldwork for our own areas of research. I didn't think that I'd meet her here...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: But... Um, can you researchers just freely leave the Akademiya?

dialogues.speaker: Kaushik
dialogues.text: I wouldn't call it "leaving freely." Alrani and I are both Driyosh.

dialogues.speaker: Kaushik
dialogues.text: To us, wandering and learning are part of our research process, and as such, we are permitted to leave the Akademiya.

dialogues.speaker: Kaushik
dialogues.text: General Gorou, I can guarantee that Alrani is telling the truth...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Alright, then there's no problem.

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: Phew... I'm saved... Thank you so much...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Hiroyuki, Ookubo, this matter is settled. Go attend to your own duties.

dialogues.speaker: Hiroyuki
dialogues.text: Yes, sir.

dialogues.speaker: Ookubo Daisuke
dialogues.text: Yes, sir.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, Miss Alrani. We mistook you for someone suspicious.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: That said, while we have cleared your name, your barging into Watatsumi Island like this has made no shortage of trouble for us.

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: Eh? Are... Are you going to fine me? I—I don't have very much Mora on me...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Well, since you did claim to be a fertilizer salesperson earlier, and you're a researcher to boot...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Well, there is something you can do for us. We have a man named Iwata living here who's researching fertilizer. Miss Alrani, please lend him a hand.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: If you can help him produce some fertilizer that isn't also a public disturbance, then you're free to do research here, just like Mr. Kaushik.

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: F—Fertilizer? Wait, I... I'm just...

response.speaker: Kaushik
response.text: Alrani, this is a good opportunity to collect research material. Since you're here in Inazuma, that must mean that your thesis is still...

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: Uh... Ugh...

response.speaker: Kaushik
response.text: You know what the standards for graduation are at the Akademiya. If you can't graduate several years in a row...

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: I—I'll do it! I'll do it, alright?

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: I—I've learned about the fertilizer at Mr. Vahid's... I'll get this done in one go, just you all watch!

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Well, then we'll call this a day for now. Miss Alrani, the fertilizer matter is in your hands. I've got some other matters to handle, so if you'll excuse me...

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Ah, yes. Please remind Iwata to, uh, move his fertilizer a bit further away.

response.speaker: Kaushik
response.text: Alright, I'll continue with my research now. If you have any questions, Alrani, just feel free to ask me.

talks.objective: Go with Alrani to look for Iwata

dialogues.speaker: Iwata
dialogues.text: Traveler, you're back. I've disposed of that pile of fertilizer.

dialogues.speaker: Iwata
dialogues.text: *sigh* I suppose I'll have to find another place to conduct my experiments...

dialogues.speaker: Iwata
dialogues.text: Hmm? This person is...

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: Hello, I'm Alrani...

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: Well, either way... The general they called Gorou requested that I assist you with your fertilizer research.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: It's a pleasure to be working with you from now on.

response.speaker: Iwata
response.text: Is that so... That's great! If we succeed, then we'll be able to plant more crops here on Watatsumi Island!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Do remember to pile the fertilizer further away.

response.speaker: Iwata
response.text: Eh? Oh! Oh, I get it.

response.speaker: Iwata
response.text: Yes, the pleasure is all mine, Miss Alrani!

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: Yeah, I'll do my best.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: I'll do my best. This is for my thesis...

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: Hello there, I'm Alrani... Wait a moment. A fertilizer specialist?

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: I... I just learned a little about them.

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: I... I'm just here to write a thesis. How in the world did I end up locked up again...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Bring Kaushik back with you. The sooner the better...

dialogues.speaker: Ookubo Daisuke
dialogues.text: I don't get how this person is supposed to look like a researcher.

dialogues.speaker: Hiroyuki
dialogues.text: What a suspicious character.
